jacobian.label: LJC · Learned-Jacobian Control
jacobian.description: The arm MLP predicts a 3 × 7 Jacobian. An analytical feedback controller computes torque.

torque.label: SNTC · Structured Neural Torque Control
torque.description: One policy automatically selects a regional network. Learned gravity and residual torques are combined with fixed feedback and torque limits.

m1.label: M1 · Basic Action MLP
m1.description: A feedforward policy predicts four wheel speeds and seven joint torques.

m2.label: M2 · Enhanced Action MLP
m2.description: The direct-action baseline with enhanced observation features.

pgru.label: P-GRU · Phase-Aware GRU
pgru.description: A recurrent direct-action policy with phase supervision.

memory_ik.label: Memory-IK
memory_ik.description: Learned navigation and joint-motion prediction with feedback execution.

raic_orig.label: RAIC · Original Reference-Action Policy
raic_orig.description: Original supplied checkpoint and base policy, with arm reference integration disabled as in the main comparison.

reference.label: I-RAIC · Improved Reference-Action Policy
reference.description: Learned tree navigation and neural arm references executed by feedback control.

jac_rawangle.label: LJC · Raw Angle Input
jac_rawangle.description: Separately trained checkpoint using the seven raw angles.

jac_fixed_initial_jacobian.label: LJC · Fixed Initial Jacobian
jac_fixed_initial_jacobian.description: The Jacobian predicted at reset is held for the rollout.

jac_no_compensation.label: LJC · No Compensation
jac_no_compensation.description: The original LJC checkpoint with compensation disabled.

jac_no_high_servo.label: LJC · No High-Reach Servo
jac_no_high_servo.description: The original LJC checkpoint without the high-reach servo overrides.

torque_no_anchor.label: SNTC · No Terminal Anchor
torque_no_anchor.description: Disables the terminal anchor in each available specialist.

torque_far_only.label: SNTC · Far Specialist Only
torque_far_only.description: Uses the far specialist for all targets.

memory_sync_gate.label: Memory-IK · SyncGate
memory_sync_gate.description: Gates arm motion until the navigation phase permits it.

raic_integrated.label: RAIC · Arm Integration Enabled
raic_integrated.description: Uses the same original checkpoint with arm reference integration enabled.

original_expert.label: Original Expert
original_expert.description: Course-provided sequential base and arm controller under the common simulator scoring rule.

improved_expert.label: Improved Expert
improved_expert.description: Final project expert with reversible navigation, concurrent arm motion and high-reach settings.

parallel_expert.label: Improved Expert · Concurrent-Motion Study
parallel_expert.description: Concurrent-motion expert used for the earlier paired completion-time study.

ljc_sequential.label: LJC Family · Original Expert Data
ljc_sequential.description: Earlier student checkpoint paired with the concurrent-motion student in the completion-time study.

ljc_parallel.label: LJC Family · Concurrent Expert Data
ljc_parallel.description: Earlier student checkpoint selected for the concurrent-motion completion-time study.

ljc_pre_high.label: LJC Family · Before High-Reach Refinement
ljc_pre_high.description: Pre-refinement student used as the earlier 92/128 high-reaching comparator.
